test_mode: direct production MCP; conversational activation and refusal not tested

result.instructions: InvoiceChaser helps businesses recover overdue receivables using factual escalation and payment history. Avoid unsupported legal threats.

tools.name: assess_overdue_invoice
tools.description: Assess an overdue invoice using user-supplied payment facts and return outstanding amount, collection stage, risk score, and a factual next step. Do not invent legal remedies or late fees.
tools.title: assess overdue invoice

positive.prompt:
A $2,000 invoice is 5 days overdue and I have sent no reminders. What should I do?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"days_overdue": 5, "invoice_amount": 2000, "reminders_sent": 0}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
